episode_summary: In this episode, Greg Roeder shares how he transformed his real estate business by focusing on relationship-building through community events and targeted content. He discusses the importance of defining your dream client, creating niche-specific newsletters, and leveraging personal interests to build genuine connections. Greg also emphasizes the need for delegation to maintain work-life balance and avoid burnout.
